source.title: Necessary and sufficient graphical conditions for optimal adjustment sets in causal graphical models with hidden variables
source.transcription: Exact migration of the nine graph fixtures formerly in tests/python/test_runge_adjustment.py paper_graph(). Original edges visually transcribed from rendered arXiv v4 pp. 3, 6, 12; migration changes storage only.
source.adjudication: Reported O-sets and graphical optimality remain separately checked by independent graph and linear-SEM oracles in tests/python/test_runge_adjustment.py. Migration identity is protected by pre-extraction hashes.
